<ApiTitle method="post" title="Resend Signing Email" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/turbosign/documents/{documentId}/resend-email"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends the original signing invitation again to recipients whose turn it is and who have not signed. The request is all or nothing: if any ID is not eligible, no email is sent.
